prompt: For each month of 2025, a report needs the number of new LedgerLoop subscriptions (subscription_events with event_type 'new', by event_date), with 0 for a month that had none. Which query returns one row for each month, with the columns month and new_subscriptions?

options.text:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), new_subs AS (
  -- one row per month with new subscriptions
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_subscriptions
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'new'
    AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT month, new_subscriptions
FROM new_subs

WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), new_subs AS (
  -- one row per month with new subscriptions
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_subscriptions
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'new'
    AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, n.new_subscriptions
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN new_subs n ON n.month = m.month

WITH months AS (
  -- one row per day of 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
), new_subs AS (
  -- one row per month with new subscriptions
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_subscriptions
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'new'
    AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, COALESCE(n.new_subscriptions, 0) AS new_subscriptions
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN new_subs n ON n.month = m.month
